"Remote Work Has become more then just a fad its more like a change in the way we think about having a job being productive and how we keep work and personal life separate,Now some people may think that working from home is the bee's knees, but the truth is it's not all good things. Remote work has it's pros and cons,Remote work offer's Flexibility and convience, and it allows workers to take care of personal business and still be productive,But it also makes it hard to keep work and personal life separate and it can lead to someone working to much and not having a clear line between work and personal life.

One of the Big Plus about working remotely is that you can work from Anywhere,This being able to work from anywhere can be a big plus to some people especialy to people that has to take care of kids or other family members,people who has a long term illness and people that wants to live some where else,Working from home can also help cut down on the time and the cost of getting to and from work which can be good for a persons health all around,But this being able to work from anywhere comes with some downsides,When you don't have a set schedule like you do in an office it's easy to work to much or get lonely,And when you don't have face to face time with your coworkers it can make a person feel left out and it can cause the work team to not stick together as much.
